recipes.title: Run or inspect a GitHub Actions workflow

steps.say: Inventory shows the live state first: open Gh to see what you are about to change.
Open Actions and find the "GitHub Actions" form.
Read the command preview under the form - it is exactly what the step says - then press the form's button. The output appears under it and in Equivalent CLI commands.

recipes.verify: Back on Inventory the change is visible; Check my work grades it like the console command.

recipes.title: Do this step from Guided tasks

steps.say: Open Guided tasks - this lab's tasks, every command a Run button.
Expand the task, check the command in the box (edit it if you need to) and press Run.
Read the output under the step before moving to the next one.
